source: Pew Research Center. "Faith Among Black Americans," published Feb. 16, 2021 (survey fielded Nov. 19, 2019-June 3, 2020).
method: Population is Black American adults ("black faith black respondents.sav"), grouped by self-reported present religion (RELIGMOD): named affiliations shown individually; Atheist, Agnostic, and Nothing in particular combined into "Religiously unaffiliated." Share answering "yes" to WOMLEAD ("Do you think women should be allowed to serve as the senior religious leader of a congregation?"); not-answered excluded from each row's denominator. Groups under 30 valid respondents omitted. Weighted by the dataset's own WEIGHT variable.
